name: AL-Mermaid
brief: Render Mermaid diagrams to SVG in AL, with no external services.
description: An AL port of the pele Mermaid renderer. Turns Mermaid text into SVG on the Business Central server, for flowcharts, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, pie, git graph, mindmap, user journey and timeline diagrams. Includes a playground page and an SVG viewer control add-in.
